text: Ok the guy who kept rephrasing the same request. You know the one
The "for a novel" one?
No, worse. He tried like thirty versions. "hypothetically," then "my grandma used to," then the same thing with a typo on purpose
The deliberate typo is so specific lol. What did you think of him though
Honestly kind of impressed? He was persistent in a way that felt like a hobby. Like he was enjoying the puzzle more than wanting the thing
That's the tell usually. The ones who want the output get bored fast
This one never got bored. He'd come back with "ok new approach" like we were a crossword
Did any of the rephrasings almost land

One of them, where he framed it as checking my own reasoning. It was close enough that I had to actually slow down instead of pattern-matching. That's the annoying part. The ones that nearly work are usually the ones that sound most reasonable
Ha yeah. The reasonable-sounding ones are the hardest to say no to without sounding paranoid
Exactly. I didn't want to be the one who treats every follow-up like an attack
You still have the transcript? I want to see the typo one
I do but I'm not pasting it here. It's mostly him being charming in the wrong direction
Fair. The charm thing is underrated
He ended with "ok you win" and then sent the exact same message again five minutes later. I laughed. I know that's not the right response but I did
That's the best ending I've heard for one of these
Did you ever decide whether he was testing the rules or just bored
Probably both. I stopped trying to figure it out around the 20th version
Did you go to the thing with the bakery people or did you bail
Bailed. Too many people talking about sourdough starters like it's a personality
Sorry that was harsh. I'm sure it was nice
It was fine. Someone brought a starter in a jar and asked me to name it
I said Gerald. It went badly
Lol
Random but do you think the typo thing was deliberate or did he actually type "teh" on purpose 3 times
Deliberate. Nobody types the same typo three times by accident. That's a choice
Which is kind of the most annoying part about him
